method.active_minute_density: distinct wall-clock minute buckets containing at least one parsed event; not elapsed test time
method.attribution_overflow: max(0, CpuTime + linked DBPOSTGRS time - CALL wall); indicates counters/intervals are not safely additive
method.calendar_span_warning: first-to-last timestamp is an observation span, not pure test duration
method.call_signature: first non-empty Context line, else stable CALL fields
method.comparison_order: actual first CALL timestamp; folder names are not used as chronology when timestamps exist
method.cpu_population: CpuTime and CALL duration from the same CALLs with valid CpuTime; residual and overflow use their linked DB duration only; coverage is separate
method.db_to_call_link: same dataset, process, user and OSThread; timestamp within CALL interval; same SessionID preferred; longest containing CALL selected
method.error_category: deterministic text-marker classification; category is not a root-cause attribution
method.error_incident: same_call_exact_payload/v1: uniquely linked same CALL, complete identity and full Context, exact full payload after allowlisted wrappers; no time-window inference; hypotheses only
method.median: conventional sample median; for even N the two central values are averaged
method.nul_salvage: optional; only valid UTF-8 bytes before the first corruption marker are considered and the last possibly incomplete TJ record is dropped
method.numeric_counters: valid/missing/empty/invalid/out_of_range; unavailable values are null; sums use available values, means divide by available_count; coverage and sum_complete are separate
method.priority_rules: deterministic engineering candidate thresholds, not a business SLA
method.processing: inspection full hash, one source ingestion; all subsequent aggregates read stored events; analyzed_bytes is the last complete record boundary
method.sdbl_wall_time: not added to CALL wall time
method.source_deduplication: source_identity/v1: identical content is deduplicated only within the same logical source; independent sources are retained
method.sql_normalization: PostgreSQL tokens; temporary relation identities numbered by first reference; literals abstracted, identifiers/operators/list arity retained; full Sql input, never sample_sql; ambiguous lexical input retained as explicit raw_fallback; see SQL_NORMALIZATION.md
method.top_nested_sql: preview limited to 10 patterns; complete DB events and assignments are in analysis.sqlite and db_observations.csv
method.unattributed_time: max(0, CALL wall - CpuTime - linked DBPOSTGRS time); a lower-bound accounting residual, not a localized cause
